scope: Relative file targets in staged Markdown, including Git index availability. External availability and Markdown anchors are not inferred by this check.
whitespace_check: Clean outside original user proposal and preserved failed-test transcript; their existing whitespace is intentionally retained.
frozen_scientific_files: No pre-existing tracked model, measurement, dataset, or protocol file modified; changed historical research-direction prose only gains an explicit superseded banner.
ci_checkout: Both checkout steps initialize the pinned Embench submodule for tests that read benchmark sources.
